mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DIARY ( MEMBER_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE, LOCATION_NAME, WEATHER_ICON, WEATHER_DESC, WEATHER_TEMP, TRACK_NAME, ARTIST_NAME, ALBUM_IMAGE_URL, SPOTIFY_TRACK_URI, IS_PUBLIC ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{latitude, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{longitude, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{locationName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{weatherIcon, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{weatherDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{weatherTemp, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{trackName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{artistName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{albumImageUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{spotifyTrackUri, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{isPublic, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT D.DIARY_ID, D.MEMBER_ID, D.TITLE, D.CONTENT, D.LATITUDE, D.LONGITUDE, D.LOCATION_NAME, D.WEATHER_ICON, D.WEATHER_DESC, D.WEATHER_TEMP, D.TRACK_NAME, D.ARTIST_NAME, D.ALBUM_IMAGE_URL, D.SPOTIFY_TRACK_URI, D.IS_PUBLIC, D.CREATED_AT, M.NICKNAME AS authorNickname, M.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS authorProfileImgUrl FROM DIARY D JOIN MEMBER M ON D.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE D.DIARY_ID = #{diaryId}
mapper.update: UPDATE DIARY SET TITLE = #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CONTENT = #{content, jdbcType=CLOB}, IS_PUBLIC = #{isPublic, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE DIARY_ID = #{diaryId}
mapper.select: SELECT DIARY_ID, MEMBER_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, LOCATION_NAME, WEATHER_ICON, WEATHER_DESC, WEATHER_TEMP, TRACK_NAME, ARTIST_NAME, ALBUM_IMAGE_URL, IS_PUBLIC, CREATED_AT FROM DIARY WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT D.DIARY_ID, D.MEMBER_ID, D.TITLE, D.CONTENT, D.LOCATION_NAME, D.WEATHER_ICON, D.WEATHER_DESC, D.WEATHER_TEMP, D.TRACK_NAME, D.ARTIST_NAME, D.ALBUM_IMAGE_URL, D.IS_PUBLIC, D.CREATED_AT, M.NICKNAME AS authorNickname, M.PROFILE_IMG_URL AS authorProfileImgUrl FROM DIARY D JOIN MEMBER M ON D.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE D.IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' ORDER BY D.CREATED_AT DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DIARY WHERE IS_PUBLIC = 'Y'

SELECT TRACK_NAME AS trackName, ARTIST_NAME AS artistName, MAX(ALBUM_IMAGE_URL) AS albumImageUrl, MAX(SPOTIFY_TRACK_URI) AS spotifyTrackUri, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM DIARY WHERE IS_PUBLIC = 'Y' AND TRACK_NAME IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(CREATED_AT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) GROUP BY TRACK_NAME, ARTIST_NAME ORDER BY cnt DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
